patch_description: A fundamentally different approach: multi-start simulated annealing in barycentric coordinates with adaptive temperature scheduling, directed moves that target the worst (minimum-area) triplet directly, and final coordinate-descent polishing. Unlike one-point random perturbation local search (which gets trapped easily), annealing escapes local optima, and the "move the vertex that forms the worst triangle" heuristic directs the search toward the binding constraint, dramatically improving convergence per iteration. Deterministic seeding ensures reproducibility.
